subject: general
question: Who was the first Finance Minister of Independent India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** RK Shanmukham Chetty.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• R.K. Shanmukham Chetty__

 __
 
• He was a lawyer, economist, and politician who served as independent India's first finance minister from 1947 to 1949.
 
• He presented independent India's first Union budget on 26 November 1947.
 
• He was a strong supporter of the Tamil Isai Movement.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• John Mathai__

 __
 
• He was an economist who served as India's first Railway Minister and subsequently as India's Finance Minister.
 
• He was the first Chairman of the State Bank of India when it was set up in 1955.
 
 
 
• C. D. Deshmukh__
 __
 
• He was the first Indian to be appointed as the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India in 1943.
 
• He served as the Finance Minister in the Union Cabinet (1950- 1956).
 
 
 
• **Liaquat Ali Khan__**
 __
 
• **​__**He served as the first Prime Minister of Pakistan from 1947 until his assassination in 1951.
 
• He was instrumental in the **Pakistan Movement** and significantly contributed to the drafting of Pakistan’s early policies.
